List every safety warning in this manual excerpt, in order, one line each:

PW-2200 ELECTRIC PRESSURE WASHER: OPERATING INSTRUCTIONS
Before first use
Read this entire manual before operating the PW-2200. Keep it for future reference. Unpack all parts and check them against the parts list on page 3. Do not use the washer if any part is missing or damaged.
Electrical safety
Connect the washer only to a grounded outlet protected by a ground fault circuit interrupter (GFCI). Never use an extension cord longer than 15 meters, and use only cords rated for outdoor use with a minimum wire gauge of 14 AWG. Do not touch the plug or outlet with wet hands. Keep all electrical connections dry and off the ground.
Water supply
Use only cold water from a household tap with a pressure between 1 and 8 bar. Never run the pump without water; doing so for more than 30 seconds can damage the seals and will void the warranty. Do not draw water from ponds, pools, or rain barrels unless you fit the optional suction filter (part SF-10).
Operating the washer
Always wear safety glasses and closed-toe shoes. Never point the spray at people, animals, electrical equipment, or the washer itself. Hold the spray gun with both hands; the recoil at start-up can be strong. Start with the 40-degree nozzle and move closer gradually. Do not use the 0-degree nozzle on wood, car paint, or tires, because it can cut into the surface. Release the trigger lock only when you are ready to spray.
Detergents
Use only detergents labeled for pressure washers. Do not use bleach, acids, or solvents such as paint thinner or gasoline. Rinse the detergent tank with clean water after each use.
After use
Turn off the motor, unplug the washer, and squeeze the trigger to release any remaining pressure before disconnecting hoses. In freezing weather, store the washer indoors; water left in the pump can freeze and crack the housing. Wind the hose loosely to avoid kinks.
Maintenance
Clean the inlet filter every 10 hours of use. If the pressure drops or pulses, check the nozzle for blockages with the cleaning pin supplied. Do not attempt to open the motor housing; servicing must be done by an authorized repair center.
